mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_messenger_conversation ( tenant_id, psid, page_id, profile_name, contact_id, lead_id, last_message_at, last_message_preview, last_customer_message_at, last_outbound_at, unread_count, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{psid}, #{pageId}, #{profileName}, #{contactId}, #{leadId}, #{lastMessageAt}, #{lastMessagePreview}, #{lastCustomerMessageAt}, #{lastOutboundAt}, COALESCE(#{unreadCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 'active'), #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, psid) DO UPDATE SET page_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.page_id, crm_messenger_conversation.page_id), profile_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.profile_name, crm_messenger_conversation.profile_name), last_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_message_at, last_message_preview = EXCLUDED.last_message_preview, last_customer_message_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_customer_message_at, crm_messenger_conversation.last_customer_message_at), last_outbound_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_outbound_at, crm_messenger_conversation.last_outbound_at), unread_count = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.unread_count, crm_messenger_conversation.unread_count), update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_messenger_conversation SET user_id = #{userId}, owner = #{owner}, assigned_at = #{assignedAt}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
